en: One study. Too many tools. Clean the data here, analyze it there, then plot and format it somewhere else.
zh: 一项研究，太多软件。在这里清洗，在那里分析，作图和排版又要换个地方。

en: Meet MedStat Pilot. One workbench, from raw data to manuscript.
zh: MedStat Pilot：从原始数据到论文，一个工作台。

en: Drop in a file, and it's understood instantly. Variable types, missing values, ranges.
zh: 拖入文件，即刻识别：变量类型、缺失值、取值范围。

en: Every edit happens on a working copy. Your original file is never touched.
zh: 所有编辑都在工作副本上进行，原始文件从不改动。

en: Compute, recode, or batch-edit variables. It's all built in.
zh: 变量计算、重编码、批量处理，全部内置。

en: Along with medical-standard conversions, smart merging, and AI-assisted text coding.
zh: 还有医学标准转换、智能合并与 AI 文本编码。

en: Then export to Excel, SPSS, or Stata.
zh: 完成后可导出 Excel、SPSS 或 Stata 格式。

en: Seventeen research domains. More than a hundred statistical methods.
zh: 17 个研究领域，100 余种统计方法。
cap: 17 research domains. More than 100 statistical methods.

en: Pick a method, drag in your variables, and press Run. No code required.
zh: 选方法、拖变量、点运行——不写一行代码。

en: In seconds, you get an APA-style table, a publication-ready figure, and an AI interpretation.
zh: 几秒钟，APA 三线表、出版级图表与 AI 解读一起生成。

en: The AI reads your results like a statistician: the key finding, its clinical meaning, and even the sentence for your paper.
zh: AI 像统计师一样读懂结果：核心结论、临床意义，甚至论文里的那句话。

en: Not sure which test to use? Ask the assistant. It knows statistics, and the shape of your data.
zh: 不确定该用什么检验？问问 AI 助手——它懂统计，也懂你的数据结构。

en: It sees variable information, never your raw rows. And with a local model, nothing leaves your computer.
zh: 它只看到变量层面的信息，看不到原始数据行；接入本机模型，内容不离开电脑。

en: Survival curves.
zh: 生存曲线。

en: Cox regression.
zh: Cox 回归。

en: ROC analysis.
zh: ROC 分析。

en: Logistic regression.
zh: Logistic 回归。

en: Subgroup analysis.
zh: 亚组分析。

en: Meta-analysis.
zh: Meta 分析。

en: Decision curves.
zh: 决策曲线。

en: And machine-learning prediction models, side by side.
zh: 还有机器学习预测模型，并排对比。

en: Every figure is journal-ready. Choose a chart type and palette, then download at three hundred or six hundred DPI.
zh: 每张图都达到期刊标准：选好图型与配色，300 或 600 DPI 一键下载。
cap: Every figure is journal-ready. Choose a chart type and palette, then download at 300 or 600 DPI.

en: One click builds a Word report. Parameters, tables, and figures, already formatted.
zh: 一键生成 Word 报告：参数、三线表、图表，排版就绪。

en: You also get a reproducible R script. Run it anywhere, and the numbers match exactly.
zh: 同时得到可复现的 R 脚本——在任何地方重跑，结果完全一致。

en: For bigger projects, the AI-R Studio takes you from study design to script, execution, and automatic repair.
zh: 更大的课题，交给 AI-R 研究工作台：从研究设计到脚本、执行与自动修复。

en: So what's really different? It's a new way to work.
zh: 真正的不同是什么？是一种全新的工作方式。

en: One workbench, instead of five tools.
zh: 一个工作台，取代五个软件。

en: A guided flow, instead of menus and syntax.
zh: 引导式流程，取代繁杂菜单与语法。

en: Tables and figures that are ready, not retyped.
zh: 表格与图表直接可用，无需手工重排。

en: Interpretation, not just output.
zh: 不只给出结果，更给出解读。

en: Reproducible, by design.
zh: 可复现，从设计之初就是如此。

en: And modern methods, built right in.
zh: 前沿方法，开箱即用。

en: On macOS and Windows, in English or Chinese.
zh: macOS 与 Windows 双平台，中英文界面。

en: MedStat Pilot. From data, to discovery.
zh: MedStat Pilot，从数据，到发现。

en: Hand the tedium to AI. Give researchers their time back, to think through the questions that truly matter.
zh: 把繁琐交给 AI，把时间还给研究者——去想清楚一个真正的科学问题。
